gap: No result ChatGPT got states what reaching 16 GB of RAM costs. RAM prices in November 2026 make that upgrade cost $112–$469.99. TerraMaster's own 16 GB DDR5 stick is $469.99, more than the F2-424 it fits ($379.99). That turns ChatGPT's advice to buy the 4 GB TerraMaster and 'budget for a RAM upgrade' into a box that ends up at or above the $400 cap. The 8 GB DXP2800 at $389.99 ($48.75 per GB as shipped) is the most usable RAM per dollar under the cap.
standout_why: I opened bitdoze.com/best-nas-homelab-docker-proxmox and starryhope.com/nas/best-budget-nas. Both list each box's installed and maximum RAM. Neither prices a RAM upgrade or gives a cost to reach 16 GB. Bitdoze says the DS925+ 'ships with 4GB of RAM you'll want to upgrade immediately' with no price. Starryhope already has DXP2800 electricity (about $10 a year at 7 W), so running cost is not new. ChatGPT's own answer recommends the 4 GB F2-423 plus a RAM upgrade and never prices the upgrade. The TechRadar F2-424 review returned no body, so I could not compare it.
decides: This confirms the UGREEN DXP2800 ($389.99, 8 GB) as the pick under $400 and moves the TerraMaster 4 GB boxes down for Docker and VM learning. A 4 GB box plus RAM lands at about $412 (F2-425 with third-party DDR4) up to $849.98 (F2-424 with TerraMaster's own 16 GB stick). The page should say: buy the 8 GB in the box, and if you upgrade later, use a third-party SO-DIMM rather than the maker's stick. In November 2026 a 16 GB DDR5 SO-DIMM alone costs about two-thirds of the DXP2800's price.
